summary: Dingdong (Cayman) Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting Q1 2026 results and disclosed its ongoing divestiture of its China business to Meituan (HKEX: 3690). The definitive agreement was announced on February 5, 2026, with the registrant selling its China operations. Exact terms (price, premium) are not disclosed in this filing. The company intends to use a substantial majority of proceeds for share repurchases or dividends. The transaction is pending SAMR anti-monopoly clearance, with customary conditions. Under US GAAP, the China business is classified as discontinued operations and held-for-sale, adding ~RMB138M to net income quarterly. Watch for regulatory clearance and announcement of specific deal terms for risk-arb analysis.
